ActivateRouterInterface.title: Activate a router interface

ActiveFlowLog.title: Activate a flow log

AddBgpNetwork.title: Advertise a BGP network
AddBgpNetwork.summary: Invokes the AddBgpNetwork operation to advertise a Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) network.

AddCommonBandwidthPackageIp.title: Add an EIP to an internet shared bandwidth instance
AddCommonBandwidthPackageIp.summary: Adds an elastic IP address (EIP) to an Internet Shared Bandwidth instance.

AddCommonBandwidthPackageIps.title: Add multiple eIPs to an internet shared bandwidth instance
AddCommonBandwidthPackageIps.summary: Adds multiple elastic IP addresses (EIPs) to an Internet Shared Bandwidth instance.

AddGlobalAccelerationInstanceIp.title: Add an EIP to a specified internet shared bandwidth instance
AddGlobalAccelerationInstanceIp.summary: Adds an Elastic IP Address (EIP) to a specified Internet Shared Bandwidth instance.

AddIPv6TranslatorAclListEntry.title: Add an IP entry to an access control policy group
AddIPv6TranslatorAclListEntry.summary: Adds an IP entry to an access control policy group.

AddPublicIpAddressPoolCidrBlock.title: Add a CIDR block to an IP address pool
AddPublicIpAddressPoolCidrBlock.summary: Adds a CIDR block to an IP address pool.

AddSourcesToTrafficMirrorSession.title: Add traffic mirror sources to a traffic mirror session
AddSourcesToTrafficMirrorSession.summary: Adds traffic mirror sources to a traffic mirror session by calling the AddSourcesToTrafficMirrorSession operation.

AllocateEipAddress.title: Apply for an elastic IP address (EIP)
AllocateEipAddress.summary: Applies for an elastic IP address (EIP).

AllocateEipAddressPro.title: Allocate a specified EIP
AllocateEipAddressPro.summary: Allocates a specified elastic IP address (EIP) for specific network configuration requirements.

AllocateEipSegmentAddress.title: Apply for contiguous eIPs
AllocateEipSegmentAddress.summary: Contiguous Elastic IP (EIP) addresses are a group of sequentially ordered elastic public IP addresses. When designing your network, you can apply for and use these IP addresses in bulk for cloud resources that require contiguous public IP addresses. You can call the AllocateEipSegmentAddress operation to apply for contiguous EIPs.

AllocateIpv6Address.title: Create an iPv6 address
AllocateIpv6Address.summary: Invokes the AllocateIpv6Address operation to allocate a free IPv6 address or IPv6 prefix CIDR block. The address is not associated with any resource instance (such as a network interface controller (NIC) or Network Load Balancer (NLB)) and exists as an independent IPv6 address in the virtual private cloud (VPC).

AllocateIpv6InternetBandwidth.title: Purchase internet bandwidth for an iPv6 address
AllocateIpv6InternetBandwidth.summary: Enables Internet bandwidth for an IPv6 address in a VPC so that the IPv6 address can communicate over the Internet. After Internet bandwidth is enabled, the IPv6 address can both initiate outbound connections to the Internet and be accessed from the Internet.

AllocateVpcIpv6Cidr.title: Reserve a specified iPv6 CIDR block
AllocateVpcIpv6Cidr.summary: Reserves a specified IPv6 CIDR block.

ApplyPhysicalConnectionLOA.title: Apply for LOA
ApplyPhysicalConnectionLOA.summary: Applies for a Letter of Authorization (LOA) for an Express Connect circuit.

AssociateEipAddress.title: Associate an EIP with a cloud resource instance
AssociateEipAddress.summary: Associates an elastic IP address (EIP) with a cloud resource instance in the same region.

AssociateEipAddressBatch.title: Associate multiple eIPs with a cloud service instance in a batch
AssociateEipAddressBatch.summary: Associates multiple Elastic IP Addresses (EIPs) with a cloud service instance in the same region in a batch.

AssociateHaVip.title: Attach an HaVip to a VPC ECS instance
AssociateHaVip.summary: Invokes the AssociateHaVip operation to attach an HaVip to an ECS instance or elastic network interface (ENI) in a virtual private cloud (VPC).

AssociateMacSecKey.title: Associate a mACsec key
AssociateMacSecKey.summary: Associates a MACsec key with a dedicated Express Connect circuit port. MACsec uses dedicated encryption chips (such as NICs or switches) to implement low-latency encryption and decryption, directly encrypting physical links (such as optical fibers or Ethernet) to cover all traffic from the sender to the receiver.

AssociateNetworkAcl.title: Associate a network ACL with a vSwitch
AssociateNetworkAcl.summary: Attaches a network ACL to a vSwitch.

AssociatePhysicalConnectionToVirtualBord.title: Associate a VBR with an express connect circuit
AssociatePhysicalConnectionToVirtualBord.summary: Associates a Virtual Border Router (VBR) with an Express Connect circuit.

AssociateRouteTable.title: Associate a route table with a vSwitch
AssociateRouteTable.summary: Associates a custom route table with a vSwitch in the same VPC.

AssociateRouteTableWithGateway.title: Associate a gateway route table with a gateway
AssociateRouteTableWithGateway.summary: Associates a gateway route table with an IPv4 gateway or IPv6 gateway instance in the same VPC by calling the AssociateRouteTableWithGateway operation.

AssociateRouteTablesWithVpcGatewayEndpoi.title: Associate route tables with a VPC gateway endpoint
AssociateRouteTablesWithVpcGatewayEndpoi.summary: Associates route tables with a VPC gateway endpoint by calling the AssociateRouteTablesWithVpcGatewayEndpoint operation.

AssociateVpcCidrBlock.title: Add a secondary CIDR block to a VPC
AssociateVpcCidrBlock.summary: Adds a secondary CIDR block to a VPC.

AssociateVpnGatewayWithCertificate.title: Associate a VPN gateway with a certificate
AssociateVpnGatewayWithCertificate.summary: Associates a certificate with a VPN gateway by calling the AssociateVpnGatewayWithCertificate operation.

AttachDhcpOptionsSetToVpc.title: Attach DHCP options set to VPC
AttachDhcpOptionsSetToVpc.summary: Calls the AttachDhcpOptionsSetToVpc operation to attach a DHCP options set to a VPC.

AttachVbrToVpconn.title: Associate a VBR with shared Express Connect circuits
AttachVbrToVpconn.summary: Associates a Virtual Border Router (VBR) instance with shared Express Connect circuits. This API is used to migrate an existing VBR that was pushed cross-account to shared Express Connect circuits (shared port), completing the shared Express Connect circuits form transformation. Only the partner (Express Connect circuit owner) can call this operation.

CancelCommonBandwidthPackageIpBandwidth.title: Cancel EIP maximum available bandwidth setting
CancelCommonBandwidthPackageIpBandwidth.summary: Cancels the maximum available bandwidth setting for an EIP that has been added to an Internet Shared Bandwidth instance.

CancelPhysicalConnection.title: Cancel express connect circuit access
CancelPhysicalConnection.summary: Cancels the access of an Express Connect circuit. After the cancellation, the Express Connect circuit enters the Canceled state.

ChangeResourceGroup.title: Modify the resource group of an express connect circuit resource
ChangeResourceGroup.summary: Calls the ChangeResourceGroup operation to modify the resource group to which an Express Connect circuit resource belongs.

CheckCanAllocateVpcPrivateIpAddress.title: Check private IP address availability in a vSwitch
CheckCanAllocateVpcPrivateIpAddress.summary: Checks whether a private IP address in a vSwitch is available.

CheckVpnBgpEnabled.title: Query whether the region of an iPsec-VPN connection supports BGP
CheckVpnBgpEnabled.summary: Calls the CheckVpnBgpEnabled operation to query whether the region to which an IPsec-VPN connection belongs supports the BGP feature.

CompletePhysicalConnectionLOA.title: Complete construction
CompletePhysicalConnectionLOA.summary: Calls CompletePhysicalConnectionLOA to complete the construction and backfill the completion information after the LOA is approved and the line construction is finished.

ConfirmPhysicalConnection.title: Confirm that an express connect circuit is available
ConfirmPhysicalConnection.summary: Confirms that an Express Connect circuit is available. The status of the Express Connect circuit changes to Confirmed.

ConnectRouterInterface.title: Initiate a connection from the requester router interface to the accepter
ConnectRouterInterface.summary: Initiates a connection from the requester VPC router interface to the accepter.

ConvertBandwidthPackage.title: Convert a NAT service plan to an internet shared bandwidth instance

CopyNetworkAclEntries.title: Copy network ACL rules
CopyNetworkAclEntries.summary: Calls the CopyNetworkAclEntries operation to copy network ACL rules.

CreateBgpGroup.title: Create a BGP group for a specified VBR
CreateBgpGroup.summary: Creates a BGP group for a specified Virtual Border Router (VBR).

CreateBgpPeer.summary: Adds a BGP peer to a specified BGP group.

CreateCommonBandwidthPackage.summary: Creates an Internet Shared Bandwidth instance by calling the CreateCommonBandwidthPackage operation.

CreateDefaultVSwitch.title: Create a default vSwitch
CreateDefaultVSwitch.summary: Creates a default vSwitch by calling the CreateDefaultVSwitch operation.

CreateDefaultVpc.title: Create a default VPC
CreateDefaultVpc.summary: Creates a default virtual private cloud (VPC).

CreateEnhancedVpnGateway.title: Create an enhanced VPN gateway
CreateEnhancedVpnGateway.summary: Creates an enhanced VPN gateway by calling the CreateEnhancedVpnGateway operation.

CreateExpressCloudConnection.title: Create an express Cloud connection instance
CreateExpressCloudConnection.summary: Creates an Express Cloud Connection (ECC) instance.

CreateExpressConnectTrafficQos.title: Create an express connect qoS policy
CreateExpressConnectTrafficQos.summary: Creates a Quality of Service (QoS) policy for Express Connect.

CreateExpressConnectTrafficQosQueue.title: Create an express connect qoS queue
CreateExpressConnectTrafficQosQueue.summary: Creates a QoS queue for Express Connect.

CreateExpressConnectTrafficQosRule.title: Create an express connect qoS rule
CreateExpressConnectTrafficQosRule.summary: Creates a QoS rule for Express Connect.

CreateFailoverTestJob.title: Create an express connect failover test job
CreateFailoverTestJob.summary: Creates a failover test job for Express Connect.

CreateForwardEntry.title: Add a DNAT entry to a DNAT table
CreateForwardEntry.summary: Adds a DNAT entry to a DNAT table by calling the CreateForwardEntry operation.

CreateFullNatEntry.title: Add a FULLNAT entry
CreateFullNatEntry.summary: Adds a FULLNAT entry to a FULLNAT table by calling the CreateFullNatEntry operation.

CreateGlobalAccelerationInstance.title: Create a global accelerator instance
CreateGlobalAccelerationInstance.summary: Creates an Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance.

CreateHaVip.title: Create a high-availability virtual IP address (HAVIP)
CreateHaVip.summary: Creates a high-availability virtual IP address (HAVIP).

CreateHighReliablePhysicalConnection.title: Create zone-redundant express connect circuits
CreateHighReliablePhysicalConnection.summary: Creates Express Connect circuits in zone redundancy mode to ensure service stability through multi-line access to Alibaba Cloud and to prevent service disruptions caused by single-line failures through multi-line disaster recovery.

CreateIPv6Translator.title: Create an iPv6 translation service instance
CreateIPv6Translator.summary: Creates an IPv6 Translation Service instance.

CreateIPv6TranslatorAclList.summary: Creates an access control policy group.

CreateIPv6TranslatorEntry.title: Add an iPv6 translation mapping entry to a translation service instance
CreateIPv6TranslatorEntry.summary: Adds an IPv6 translation mapping entry to a specified IPv6 Translation Service instance.

CreateIpsecServer.summary: Creates an IPsec server by calling the CreateIpsecServer operation.

CreateIpv6EgressOnlyRule.title: Create an iPv6 egress-only rule for an iPv6 address
CreateIpv6EgressOnlyRule.summary: Creates an IPv6 egress-only rule for an IPv6 address by calling CreateIpv6EgressOnlyRule. You can create an egress-only rule to allow ECS instances in a VPC with an IPv6 CIDR block to proactively access IPv6 endpoints on the client side, while preventing IPv6 endpoints on the client side from accessing ECS instances in the VPC over the Internet.

CreateIpv6Gateway.title: Create an iPv6 gateway
CreateIpv6Gateway.summary: Creates an IPv6 gateway. An IPv6 gateway is used to control IPv6 network traffic for a virtual private cloud (VPC).

CreateNatGateway.title: Create a NAT gateway
CreateNatGateway.summary: Creates an enhanced Internet NAT gateway or a VPC NAT gateway by calling the CreateNatGateway operation.

CreateNatIp.title: Create a NAT IP address
CreateNatIp.summary: Creates a NAT IP address for a VPC NAT gateway instance.

CreateNatIpCidr.title: Create a NAT CIDR block
CreateNatIpCidr.summary: Creates a NAT CIDR block for a VPC NAT gateway instance.

CreatePhysicalConnection.title: Apply for an express connect circuit
CreatePhysicalConnection.summary: Calls the CreatePhysicalConnection operation to apply for an Express Connect circuit.

CreatePhysicalConnectionOccupancyOrder.title: Create a resource occupation fee order
CreatePhysicalConnectionOccupancyOrder.summary: Creates an order for resource occupation fees by calling the CreatePhysicalConnectionOccupancyOrder operation.

CreatePhysicalConnectionSetupOrder.title: Create a port initial installation fee order

CreateSnatEntry.summary: Calls the CreateSnatEntry operation to add an SNAT entry to an SNAT table.

CreateSslVpnClientCert.title: Create an SSL-VPN client certificate
CreateSslVpnClientCert.summary: Calls the CreateSslVpnClientCert operation to create an SSL client certificate.

CreateTrafficMirrorFilter.summary: Invokes the CreateTrafficMirrorFilter operation to create a traffic mirror filter.

CreateTrafficMirrorFilterRules.summary: Invokes the CreateTrafficMirrorFilterRules operation to create inbound or outbound rules for a traffic mirror filter.

CreateVSwitchCidrReservation.summary: Creates a reserved CIDR block for a vSwitch.

CreateVcoRouteEntry.summary: Calls the CreateVcoRouteEntry operation to add a destination route entry to an IPsec-VPN connection.

CreateVirtualPhysicalConnection.summary: Invokes the CreateVirtualPhysicalConnection operation to create shared Express Connect circuits.

CreateVpconnFromVbr.title: Transform shared Express Connect circuits push mode
CreateVpconnFromVbr.summary: Transforms the routing mode of shared Express Connect circuits from cross-account Virtual Border Router (VBR) push to cross-account shared port push.

CreateVpnAttachment.title: Create an iPsec-VPN connection
CreateVpnAttachment.summary: Creates an IPsec-VPN connection to be associated with a transit router instance by calling the CreateVpnAttachment operation.

CreateVpnConnection.title: Create an iPsec-VPN connection
CreateVpnConnection.summary: Creates an IPsec-VPN connection by calling the CreateVpnConnection operation.

CreateVpnPbrRouteEntry.title: Create a VPN policy-based route
CreateVpnPbrRouteEntry.summary: Creates a VPN policy-based route by calling the CreateVpnPbrRouteEntry operation.

CreateVpnRouteEntry.summary: Creates a destination route for a VPN gateway instance by calling the CreateVpnRouteEntry operation. DeactivateRouterInterface.title: Freeze a router interface
DeactivateRouterInterface.summary: Freezes a router interface by calling the DeactivateRouterInterface operation.

DeactiveFlowLog.title: Stop a flow log
DeactiveFlowLog.summary: Stops a flow log instance. After the flow log is stopped, traffic of the specified resource is no longer captured.

DeleteBgpNetwork.title: Delete an advertised BGP network
DeleteBgpNetwork.summary: Deletes an advertised Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) network.

DeleteCommonBandwidthPackage.title: Delete an internet shared bandwidth instance
DeleteCommonBandwidthPackage.summary: Deletes an Internet Shared Bandwidth instance.

DeleteEnhancedVpnGateway.title: Delete a specified enhanced VPN gateway
DeleteEnhancedVpnGateway.summary: Deletes a specified enhanced VPN gateway.

DeleteExpressConnectTrafficQosQueue.summary: Calls the DeleteExpressConnectTrafficQosQueue operation to delete an Express Connect QoS queue.

DeleteExpressConnectTrafficQosRule.summary: Deletes a QoS rule for Express Connect.

DeleteFailoverTestJob.summary: Deletes an Express Connect failover test job by calling the DeleteFailoverTestJob operation.

DeleteGlobalAccelerationInstance.summary: Deletes an Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance.

DeleteHaVip.summary: Deletes a high-availability virtual IP address (HaVip).

DeleteIPv6Translator.title: Delete an iPv6 translation service instance
DeleteIPv6Translator.summary: Deletes an IPv6 Translation Service instance.

DeleteIPv6TranslatorAclList.title: Delete an access control policy group
DeleteIPv6TranslatorAclList.summary: Deletes an access control policy group. You can delete an access control policy group only when it is not associated with any IPv6 Translation Service mappings.

DeleteIPv6TranslatorEntry.title: Delete an iPv6 translation service mapping entry
DeleteIPv6TranslatorEntry.summary: Deletes an IPv6 Translation Service mapping entry.

DeleteIpv6InternetBandwidth.title: Delete internet bandwidth
DeleteIpv6InternetBandwidth.summary: Deletes the Internet bandwidth of an IPv6 address by calling the DeleteIpv6InternetBandwidth operation.

DeleteNatGateway.summary: Deletes a specified Internet NAT gateway.

DeleteNatIpCidr.summary: Deletes a NAT CIDR block by calling the DeleteNatIpCidr operation.

DeletePublicIpAddressPoolCidrBlock.summary: Deletes a CIDR block from an IP address pool by calling the DeletePublicIpAddressPoolCidrBlock operation.

DeleteRouteEntries.title: Batch delete custom route entries
DeleteRouteEntries.summary: Calls DeleteRouteEntries to batch delete custom route entries.

DeleteRouteEntry.summary: Invokes the DeleteRouteEntry operation to delete a route from the route table of a VPC vRouter or Virtual Border Router (VBR).

DeleteRouteTargetGroup.summary: Deletes a route target group instance.

DeleteSslVpnServer.summary: Deletes an SSL server. After the SSL server is deleted, the system automatically deletes all SSL client certificates associated with the SSL server, and clients that have installed these SSL client certificates are automatically disconnected from the SSL-VPN connection.

DeleteTrafficMirrorFilter.summary: Invokes the DeleteTrafficMirrorFilter operation to delete a traffic mirror filter.

DeleteTrafficMirrorFilterRules.summary: Invokes the DeleteTrafficMirrorFilterRules operation to delete inbound or outbound rules of a traffic mirror filter.

DeleteVSwitch.summary: Invokes the DeleteVSwitch operation to delete a vSwitch.

DeleteVSwitchCidrReservation.title: Delete reserved vSwitch CIDR block
DeleteVSwitchCidrReservation.summary: Deletes a reserved vSwitch CIDR block.

DeleteVbrHa.summary: Calls DeleteVbrHa to delete a VBR failover group.

DeleteVcoRouteEntry.summary: Deletes a destination route entry from an IPsec-VPN connection.

DeleteVpnRouteEntry.summary: Deletes a VPN destination route by calling the DeleteVpnRouteEntry operation.

DescribeAccessPoints.summary: Queries the access points of Express Connect circuits in a specified region by calling the DescribeAccessPoints operation.

DescribeBgpGroups.summary: Queries BGP groups in a specified region.

DescribeBgpNetworks.summary: Invokes DescribeBgpNetworks to query advertised Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) networks.

DescribeBgpPeers.summary: Queries BGP peers in a specified region.

DescribeEipGatewayInfo.summary: Queries the gateway and subnet mask information of an elastic IP address (EIP) by calling the DescribeEipGatewayInfo operation.

DescribeIPv6Translators.summary: Queries a list of created IPv6 Translation Service instances.

DescribeIpv6EgressOnlyRules.summary: Queries IPv6 egress-only rules that you created.

DescribeNatGatewayAssociateNetworkInterf.summary: Queries the list of elastic network interfaces (ENIs) associated with a VPC NAT gateway when the VPC NAT gateway is referenced as an EPS resource by PrivateLink. This feature is currently not available.

DescribeNatGateways.summary: Queries the details of NAT gateways that meet specified conditions in a specified region.

DescribeNetworkAcls.summary: Queries a list of network ACLs by calling the DescribeNetworkAcls operation.

DescribePhysicalConnectionLOA.summary: Queries the Letter of Authorization (LOA) information of an Express Connect circuit.

UpdatePublicIpAddressPoolAttribute.title: Modify IP address pool attributes

UpdateTrafficMirrorSessionAttribute.summary: Modifies the configuration of a traffic mirror session.
